title: CLIP
paper_title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
core_mech: 完全分离的图像/文本双塔，通过批内 N×N 对称对比目标对齐，并用文本 prompt 充当开放词表分类器。
core_mech_en: Aligns separate image and text encoders in a shared embedding space via symmetric in-batch N×N contrastive loss, turning text prompts into zero-shot classifiers.
input_desc: 批量图像与自然语言文本配对
input_en: Mini-batch of N paired (image, natural-language caption) samples
output_desc: 共享嵌入空间中的图像/文本向量与零样本类别分数
output_en: L2-normalized shared-space image/text embeddings and cosine zero-shot classification logits

adapter.name: CLIP
adapter.mechanism: Original OpenAI ViT image encoder, causal text Transformer, EOT pooling, learned logit scale and symmetric image–text contrastive loss.
limitations: Unmodified MIT author architecture with smaller dimensions and random initialization; no pretrained weights or foundation-pretraining claim.

Synthetic grayscale images are repeated into RGB. A 32-token teaching vocabulary replaces byte-pair tokenization; EOS=2 is explicitly remapped to the largest token ID required by original CLIP pooling.
Paired diagonal contrastive targets are retained. Repeated short synthetic descriptions can be false negatives; tiny batches do not establish semantic retrieval or zero-shot quality.
